name: Leaellynasaura
sum: A small herbivorous ornithopod of the Early Cretaceous of Victoria, Australia, which lived within the Antarctic Circle.
wsnote: Estimated at about 180 cm including the tail; the long-tailed postcranial skeletons once assigned to it could not be confidently referred in a 2013 revision.
holotype: MV P185991, an incomplete cranium, from the Eumeralla Formation.
material: A right maxilla (MV P186352) and a tooth (MV P186412) are the other confidently referred pieces.
biology: A small herbivore; the extremely long tail once reported for it is doubtful after the 2013 revision.
author: Rich and Vickers-Rich 1989
